=== lib/kinds.dart
enum Color {
  red;

  void paint() {}
}

extension on String {
  int get twice => length * 2;
}

extension Named on int {
  void hello() {}
}

extension type Meters(double value) {
  Meters.zero() : this(0);
}

mixin Walker on Object {
  void walk() {}
}

int get topGetter => 1;

set topSetter(int value) {}

typedef Callback = void Function();

var counter = 0;

class Point(final int x, final int y) {
  int get sum => x + y;
}

class Modern {
  const new();
  new named();
  int operator +(Modern other) => 0;
}
